_comment: Reviewer gate. One reviewer agent (judgment only) reads a code-built packet; a conditional red team reads a conclusions digest. max_rounds is a strict hard cap of 2; round 2 is a delta review of changed sections. See skills/_shared/REVIEWER_OPERATIONS.md.

red_team._comment: Runs unless the workflow is listed in skip_for. Round 2 runs only if round 1 asked for changes.
